nature Electrical
  potential Voltage v "V" abstol 1e-6
  flow Current i "A" abstol 1e-12
body AcRc
  node vin: Electrical signal
  node out: Electrical signal
  child v1: Vsource  nodes (vin, gnd)  params (dc = 0.0, ac = 1.0)
  child r1: Resistor  nodes (vin, out)  params (r = 1000.0)
  child c1: Capacitor  nodes (out, gnd)  params (c = 1.5915494309189535e-9)
body Capacitor
  param c: f64 where (c >= 0.0)
  node p: Electrical port
  node n: Electrical port
  branch b0 (p, n) flow
  analog
    b0.flow +> ddt (c * probe(p, n))
body Resistor
  param r: f64 where (r > 0.0)
  node p: Electrical port
  node n: Electrical port
  branch b0 (p, n) flow
  analog
    b0.flow +> direct (probe(p, n) / r)
body Vsource
  param dc: f64 = 0.0
  param ac: f64 = 0.0
  node p: Electrical port
  node n: Electrical port
  branch b0 (p, n) potential
  stim S0 "ac"
  analog
    b0.potential +> direct ((dc * source_scale()) + ac_stim S0 (ac))
instance AcRc: AcRc  nodes (AcRc.vin, AcRc.out)  params ()  top
instance AcRc.v1: Vsource  nodes (AcRc.vin, gnd)  params (dc = 0.0, ac = 1.0)
instance AcRc.r1: Resistor  nodes (AcRc.vin, AcRc.out)  params (r = 1000.0)
instance AcRc.c1: Capacitor  nodes (AcRc.out, gnd)  params (c = 1.5915494309189535e-9)
node AcRc.out: Electrical  declared by AcRc
node AcRc.vin: Electrical  declared by AcRc
